answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 94 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes an ocean bet on surviving 94 epochs of grading, and every raven settlement recomputes the prism schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 9 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 10 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
